summary: Converts a float a2 into an integer index: computes CRTFtol((a2 - base) / step + 0.5) using the reference value at this+0x58 and the step size at this+0x60, clamps the result into [0, bound-1] using the upper bound at this+0x68, stores the clamped index at this+0x6C, and returns the unclamped computed index. Called from PitStopDecisionTireCompound for array indexing.

local_names.this: container holding index parameters (base double, step double, upper bound, output index)
local_names.a2: input float value to convert to an index
local_names.result: computed index before clamping, also the return value

operations.description: Compute the raw index as CRTFtol((a2 - (double)this+0x58) / (double)this+0x60 + 0.5); this+0x58 is the reference/base value and this+0x60 the step/interval size. The computation also references the constant global dbl_59E880 (0x0059E880, DERIVED name HalfStep) whose exact role is not visible in the raw source.
CRTFtol converts the scaled double expression into an integer index.
If the computed index is >= 0, clamp it into [0, bound-1]; otherwise the result < 0 branch forces the stored value to 0.
Store the clamped index into this+0x6C: when result < this+0x68 store result, otherwise store this+0x68 - 1; the result < 0 branch stores 0.
Return the unclamped computed index (the CRTFtol result), not the stored clamped value.
